protocol.grid: 17x17 offsets -4..4 km by 0.5 km around each prior's own saved D selection; clipped to original prior disk
protocol.inventory: identical evaluated coordinates for both objectives within each prior
protocol.candidate_policy: full causal catalogue shortlist recomputed independently at every point
protocol.truth_access: reference errors are not used; the completed distance artifact is read only for source-search and contract binding

topology_receipt.rule: Exclude every whole track containing a source anchor used more than once; all train and reserve observations audited; no score, signal strength, receiver position, or satellite criteria.
